Title: Sr. AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our innovative and impact-driven Data Science and Analytics team. This role is ideal for a seasoned expert with a deep understanding of machine learning, AI, and cloud data platforms, and a strong grasp of the latest advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of scalable AI solutions—including those powered by LLMs—to accelerate digital transformation across our products, operations, and customer experiences. You'll play a critical role in shaping JCI’s AI engineering strategy, mentoring teams, and driving the use of AI to deliver measurable business value. How You Will Do It Advanced Analytics, LLMs & Modeling Design and implement advanced machine learning models including deep learning, time-series forecasting, recommendation engines, and LLM-based solutions (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude). Develop use cases around enterprise search, document summarization, conversational AI, and automated knowledge retrieval using large language models. Fine-tune or prompt-engineer foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face) for domain-specific applications. Evaluate and optimize LLM performance, latency, cost-effectiveness, and hallucination mitigation strategies for production use. Data Strategy & Engineering Collaboration Work closely with data and ML engineering teams to integrate LLM-powered applications into scalable, secure, and reliable pipelines. Contribute to the development of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Azure Cognitive Search). Support the deployment of models using MLOps principles, ensuring robust monitoring and lifecycle management. Business Impact & AI Strategy Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities for applying LLMs and generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Lead workshops or proofs-of-concept to demonstrate value of LLM use cases across business units. Translate complex model outputs, including those from LLMs, into clear insights and decision support tools for non-technical audiences. Thought Leadership & Mentorship Act as an internal thought leader on AI and LLM innovation, keeping JCI at the forefront of industry advancements. Mentor and upskill AI engineering team members in advanced AI techniques, including transformer models and generative AI frameworks. Contribute to strategic roadmaps for generative AI and model governance within the enterprise. Qualifications & Experience Education in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline. 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering, data science, or machine learning, including at least 1–2 years working with LLMs or generative AI technologies. Demonstrated success in deploying machine learning and NLP solutions at scale. Proven experience with cloud AI platforms—especially Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Hugging Face, or AWS Bedrock. Technical Expertise Proficiency in Python and SQL, including libraries like Transformers (Hugging Face), Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. Experience with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and LLM orchestration tools. Familiarity with data storage, retrieval systems, and vector databases. Strong understanding of model evaluation techniques for generative AI, including factuality, relevance, and toxicity metrics. Leadership & Soft Skills Strategic thinker with a strong ability to align AI initiatives to business goals. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, especially in articulating the value of LLMs and advanced analytics. Strong collaborator with a track record of influencing stakeholders across product, engineering, and executive teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with IoT, edge analytics, or smart building systems. Familiarity with LLMOps, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks. Knowledge of data privacy and governance considerations specific to LLM usage in enterprise environments. Coordinating the collection, validation, consolidation, and reporting of key environmental and safety performance indicators. Driving data quality through controls validation, data reviews, reconciliations, anomaly analysis, and corrective action management. Supporting audit readiness activities, including evidence preparation, stakeholder engagement, issue resolution, and external assurance reviews. Partnering with EHS, Sustainability, and business stakeholders to align reporting practices and strengthen data ownership. Monitoring emerging sustainability reporting requirements and standards, including GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1, GRI, CDP, SBTi, and CSRD/ESRS. Developing and maintaining reporting procedures, methodologies, inventory management plans, and supporting documentation. Experience supporting assurance audits, regulatory reporting, or external sustainability disclosures. Strong analytical, project management, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills. Description: Job Details Job Description: This position requires candidates to upload a resume in English; you are welcome to upload multiple versions of your resume if you prefer but an English version of your resume will be required to be considered for this position. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working hands-on technically with both internal and external teams to deliver impactful Fleet and Scale software solutions that are critical to Data Center customers. You will be part of a team responsible for developing Customer Fleet and Scale capabilities that enable high-quality Intel server product launches and improve in-fleet customer experience. The ideal candidate is a quick learner, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment. As a Senior Dev Ops Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and scaling Intel's software for data platform and analytics ecosystem. The position focuses on the design, development, deployment, and optimization of data infrastructure, telemetry processing pipelines, customer health analytics, and fleet quality solutions. You will work closely with software architects, customer engineering teams, validation organizations, and data scientists to transform large-scale platform telemetry into actionable insights that improve product quality, customer experience, defect screening, fleet reliability, and operational efficiency across Intel Xeon products. Responsibilities Develop and maintain backend components supporting software and data platform infrastructure. Work on data extraction, processing, and analysis of information collected from Intel Server Health screening applications and customer fleet telemetry solutions. Design and implement scalable data processing pipelines using distributed computing frameworks. Build and maintain fleet-scale analytics solutions supporting customer telemetry, reliability, quality, and health monitoring data. Perform queries against cloud-hosted relational and non-relational databases. Design, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries supporting large-scale data analysis workloads. Create and maintain data processing code and extraction pipelines that feed data marts and analytics platforms from enterprise data warehouses. Develop, modify, and maintain Python-based backend services and data presentation applications supporting customer and stakeholder reporting needs. Propose, develop, and enhance dashboards, visualizations, and analytics solutions used by engineering teams and customers. Deploy, manage, and optimize services running on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and modern DevOps practices. Work closely with Microsoft Azure cloud services to deploy scalable and reliable data platform solutions. Collaborate on software release planning, deployment activities, and operational readiness reviews. Identify, isolate, track, and resolve software issues throughout the development lifecycle. Perform code debugging, root-cause analysis, bug resolution, and automated test development. Optimize system performance and proactively identify scalability bottlenecks across the data platform ecosystem. Partner with customer engineering, validation, manufacturing, and fleet operations teams to analyze large-scale telemetry datasets and improve platform quality initiatives. Candidate Profile The Successful Candidate Should Bring a Combination Of Software engineering and data engineering expertise using Python and modern data frameworks. Deep understanding of large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures. Experience building telemetry analytics, fleet health monitoring, and customer quality solutions. Database architecture, data modeling, and query optimization expertise. Experience designing data marts, analytics pipelines, and scalable cloud-based data solutions. Expertise working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized applications, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. Data pipeline development, analytics, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills. Customer-focused engineering mindset with strong communication and collaboration capabilities. Operate across software architecture, validation, customer engineering, manufacturing, and quality organizations. Experience supporting large-scale Data Center and Xeon server solutions. Problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in highly dynamic technical environments. Passion for leveraging data to improve customer quality, fleet reliability, defect screening, and operational efficiency. This position is a fixed-term opportunity lasting approximately 24 months. Qualifications Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; OR Master's Degree in the same fields with 5+ years of relevant experience. Experience mentioned above should be in the following areas: Advanced Python programming skills. Experience developing and deploying applications on Kubernetes (K8s). Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins. Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases. Writing complex and optimized SQL queries. Working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets. Git, GitHub, and pull request workflows. Microsoft Azure cloud services or similar. Distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Dask. Debugging software, resolving production issues, and developing automated tests. Jupyter notebooks and interactive development environments. Docker and containerized application development. Advance English level. Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship). Preferred Qualifications Experience proposing and designing data models supporting customer analytics, data marts, and reporting solutions. Experience designing and optimizing warehouse schemas, data storage models, and large-scale analytics environments. Experience with scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and other advanced data analytics libraries. Experience developing analytics workflows supporting fleet health monitoring and customer quality initiatives. Knowledge of Linux development environments and Linux internals. Experience with cloud-native technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, AWS, and GCP. Experience with data visualization frameworks, dashboard development, and business intelligence solutions. Understanding of machine learning workflows, MLOps, and model deployment practices. Experience processing large-scale telemetry, diagnostics, validation, manufacturing, or customer fleet datasets. Understanding of Intel Xeon platforms, system telemetry, and server architecture. Title: Senior Water Data Scientist
Description: This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You can be based in our office in our office in Washington, DC or Mexico City, Mexico .  Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position. To be eligible for this position in US, you must be a resident of DC, Maryland or Virginia at the start of employment. The Senior Water Data Scientist will serve as the technical and scientific lead for a flagship initiative focused on advancing how the impacts of nature-based solutions (NBS) and green-gray infrastructure (GGI) on water security outcomes are measured and monitored across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and beyond. This role will help shape a next-generation approach to understanding causal inference and attribution for how NBS influence water availability, water quality, hydrologic regulation, drought resilience, flood risk, and watershed resilience, by convening partners to build the scientific methodologies and digital architecture that will make monitoring and measuring the water outcomes of NBS credible and accessible at scale. The Senior Water Data Scientist will work with an interdisciplinary team across WRI’s Cities4Forests, Water Program, Global Nature Watch, Data Lab, and regional offices to identify, evaluate, and apply the best available science, data, models, artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and other emerging technologies for impact measurement and monitoring (IMM). The role will help bridge cutting-edge scientific research with practical implementation needs for utilities, investors, governments, and practitioners. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: planetary causal inference -> integrating planetary-scale data and localized information to derive insights about causality AI, machine learning and data-driven environmental modeling -> Orchestrating research and scientific development with AI, such as expertise with geospatial foundation models (GFMs), experience with AI-assisted coding, and firm foundation in statistical and machine learning methods remote sensing and Earth observation geospatial analytics and environmental monitoring environmental data systems and impact measurement frameworks hydrology and watershed science forest-water dynamics and ecosystem processes integrated water resources management The role requires a strong ability to synthesize emerging science and technology into actionable methodologies, frameworks, and recommendations that support investment-ready, scientifically credible approaches to monitoring water outcomes from NBS and GGI. Scientific Leadership (50%) Lead the technical development of research and analytical approaches related to measuring and monitoring the impacts of NBS and GGI on water security outcomes in LAC. Lead and contribute to landscape syntheses, technical assessments, and methodological reviews related to hydrology, watershed monitoring, Earth observation, remote sensing, AI-enabled analytics, and environmental data systems. Identify scientific, methodological, and data gaps that constrain credible measurement of water outcomes from NBS and GGI and help define pathways for future innovation and system-scale monitoring breakthroughs. Evaluate the strengths, limitations, feasibility, and investment relevance of existing and emerging monitoring approaches, indicators, and data products. Develop scientifically rigorous and policy-relevant recommendations for impact measurement and monitoring frameworks, indicators, methodologies, and monitoring strategies. Possibility to manage other technical experts to deliver the project. AI-Enabled Methods & Monitoring (20%) Manage, analyze, and synthesize large and complex environmental datasets, including hydrologic, geospatial, remote sensing, climate, and ecological datasets. Contribute technical expertise to the development of pilot monitoring approaches and applied field implementations with regional partners. Support development and evaluation of advanced analytical approaches, including geospatial modeling, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and satellite-based monitoring systems where relevant. Author and co-author high-quality knowledge products including reports, technical papers, synthesis documents, presentations, blogs, and peer-reviewed publications. Help shape a long-term “technical vision” related to scalable water monitoring systems, foundational environmental datasets, and future “water cycle intelligence” approaches. Project Development and Project Management (15%) Co-lead the development and implementation of a multi-year initiative advancing water security impact measurement and monitoring for nature-based solutions and green-gray infrastructure. Coordinate interdisciplinary collaboration across WRI teams and external partners, including research institutions, utilities, NGOs, technical advisors, and implementation partners. Manage technical workstreams, project deliverables, timelines, peer review processes, and partner relationships to ensure high-quality project execution. Co-lead the design and implementation of pilot projects and demonstration activities to test, validate, and refine monitoring approaches under real-world conditions. Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, strategic partnerships, and donor engagement to expand WRI's water security and environmental data portfolio. Stakeholder Engagement (15%) Engage with technical experts, research institutions, NGOs, governments, utilities, companies, and other stakeholders (including those in Latin America and the Caribbean) to support knowledge exchange, collaboration, and applied learning. Coordinate and contribute technical expertise to technical advisory group, including leading discussions, workshops, webinars, and external convenings. Prepare presentations, briefings, and technical materials for internal and external audiences, including funders and senior decision-makers. Help communicate complex scientific and technical concepts to non-technical audiences in clear, actionable, and decision-relevant ways. Support coordination of project reporting, partner communications, and funder deliverables. What Will You Need Education: A BA or BS degree (Graduate Degree preferred) in a relevant field: environmental science (such as hydrology, ecology, or water resource management), geographic science (such as remote sensing and satellite technology), or data science and programming (such as computer science, machine learning or artificial intelligence), or a related field required. Master’s Degree or PhD strongly preferred. Experience: A minimum of 10 years of full-time work experience in environmental or climate science or a related field with rigorous quantitative and/or scientific components and a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of interdisciplinary and multicultural teams. Experience working with Artificial Intelligence and data science is important. You have a proven ability to synthesize data analysis and research into policy-relevant written products. Languages: Written and verbal proficiency in English, additional proficiency in Spanish is strongly preferred. Requirements: Existing work authorization is required where this position is based. WRI is unable to authorize visa work authorization. Potential Salary If based in the US: $139-175K If located in another country office, salary will be determined by local market conditions. How To Apply Salary is commensurate with experience and other compensable factors. Please submit a resume with a cover letter by September 11 , 2026 . Internal applicants should submit their application through the Jobs Hub portal in Workday. External applicants must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates. What We Offer Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields across Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America and the US The chance to have an impact and to develop your career within a mission driven organization with access to varied learning and training opportunities A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours Generous leave days that increase with tenure. If based in the US: Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, retirement plan access and employer contribution. About Us World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyse change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations. Our Mission And Values WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations. Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership and Care. Our Culture WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status. Our People team carefully reviews all applications.

Handle large, complex datasets to clean, preprocess and extract relevant features to improve product accuracy and performance. Write production-level code with documentation, testing and peer review. Work with a data-driven mindset and understand the critical importance of handling data properly and safely. Lead the testing, cost-benefit analysis and integration of new data sources to improve the accuracy and robustness of our ML models. Work closely with our ML Platform and Tooling team to design and implement scalable feature generation and extraction pipelines and model deployment/monitoring processes. Partner with Sales to understand advertiser needs, identify the underlying business question and prioritise high-value insight opportunities. Use third-party syndicated research, market intelligence and other credible sources to strengthen first-party analysis and provide wider context. Present insights and recommendations to advertisers and agencies through meetings, workshops, presentations and other strategic engagements. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Creative, Measurement and regional or global Insights colleagues to deliver integrated advertiser solutions. Independently manage well-scoped, moderately complex projects, including stakeholder alignment, analytical planning, execution and quality assurance. Contribute to reusable analytical frameworks, sales narratives, templates and processes that extend the impact of insights beyond individual requests. Use Pinterest’s evolving AI toolkit to improve the speed, scale and quality of research, analysis, coding, narrative development and reporting. Critically evaluate AI-assisted work through source-checking, testing and data validation, maintaining ownership of all final outputs and recommendations. Monitor the adoption and commercial influence of insights, gathering feedback and applying learning to future work. Minimum of 2 years of regular experience querying and manipulating data using SQL. Demonstrated experience using data to solve commercial or marketing challenges and influence stakeholder decisions. Strong insight storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into clear recommendations for different professional audiences. Experience building high-quality presentations in Google Slides, PowerPoint or an equivalent tool. Confidence presenting analytical work to clients, agencies or senior internal stakeholders. Ability to clarify ambiguous requests, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work independently. Working knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methods, audience research, market intelligence or syndicated data. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with commercial and cross-functional partners. Professional fluency in written and spoken Spanish and English. Experience using AI to accelerate analytical or research workflows, together with a clear approach to verifying accuracy, sources and quality. Experience in digital advertising, social platforms, media agencies, research agencies or consumer-facing technology is beneficial. Experience with advertisers or sectors relevant to the Mexican market is beneficial. Experience commissioning or managing primary research is beneficial. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience. An understanding of and enthusiasm for Pinterest’s mission, product and value to advertisers. Title: Lead AI Forward Engineer
Description: The Lead AI Forward Engineer designs and guides the delivery of AI-powered solutions that reduce operational toil and accelerate technology teams across the CIO organization. This role operates as a forward-deployed solution architect and engineer, partnering closely with teams to identify opportunities, design end-to-end architectures, and drive implementations to production. You will own solution design from concept through deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and extensible. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, define repeatable patterns, and help build new capabilities through hands-on implementation, mentorship, and shared standards. About The Role Solution Architecture and Delivery Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI automation and intelligent agents across CIO technology teams. Design end-to-end AI solutions, including workflows, integration patterns, data flows, and operational considerations. Guide implementation from prototype to production, ensuring solutions meet reliability, security, and compliance expectations. Define reusable architectural patterns and reference designs to enable broader adoption across teams. Build scalable pipelines to collect and analyze inference‑ and workflow‑level telemetry, integrating with TR's data backbone. Develop dashboards and reports providing clear visibility into performance, reliability, safety, and cost. Ensure compliance with TR's AI standards for monitoring, governance, privacy, and auditability. AI System Design and Technology Strategy Evaluate and recommend AI/ML technologies and platforms (LLM orchestration, agentic frameworks, cloud AI services) based on capability, cost, risk, and fit. Design flexible architectures that can evolve with model/provider changes and emerging AI capabilities. Apply sound judgment on when AI is appropriate vs. when simpler automation or traditional engineering approaches are better. Establish and track SLOs/SLIs for critical AI services to meet enterprise reliability and compliance requirements. Integrate AI observability tooling into CI/CD so new models, prompts, and workflows are automatically enrolled in monitoring and evaluation. Develop automated guardrails and policy enforcement (e.g., limits, anomaly detection, abuse/failure pattern detection) with cloud engineering and security teams. Cross Functional Partnership and Influence Partner with engineering teams, service owners, and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements and solution designs. Communicate trade-offs and design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership when needed. Mentor engineers and share patterns, practices, and lessons learned to raise overall AI solution design maturity. Partner with Product, Data Science and AI teams to design and run evaluation frameworks for LLMs/ML models (offline/online tests, benchmarks, canaries, A/B experiments). Work with Product, Data Science, AI Inference Engineering, and Enterprise AI teams to onboard new AI use cases into the observability platform from day one. Description: Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale. Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas. What you'll do We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever. You will: Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code. Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation. Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin. Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted. Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work. Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling). Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce. Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one. Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives. A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month. Nice to haves Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history). Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar). Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering. Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion. Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production. Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint). Why join Clara At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who we are We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Clara's Hybrid Policy Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Title: Coordinador de Trafico y WFM
Description: Objetivo del Puesto Garantizar el uso óptimo de los recursos humanos y tecnológicos del centro de contacto (llamadas entrantes, llamadas salientes en predictivo, WhatsApp, SMS y RCS), mediante la planeación, pronóstico y gestión en tiempo real de la demanda, así como la administración de la infraestructura de telefonía, con el fin de asegurar el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio, la eficiencia operativa y la mejor experiencia posible para los clientes atendidos por los equipos de Cobranza, Atención a Cliente y Ventas. Funciones y Responsabilidades1. Pronóstico y planeación de la demanda (Forecasting) •    Elaborar pronósticos de volumen de contactos entrantes y salientes por canal (llamadas, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS), por día e intervalo, con base en históricos y estacionalidad propia del negocio (quincenas, fin de mes, campañas, cartera de cobranza). •    Analizar los flujos de llamadas entrantes identificando máximos y mínimos por intervalo para dimensionar la plantilla necesaria en cada turno. •    Aplicar modelos de dimensionamiento de personal (Erlang C u otros) para calcular el número óptimo de agentes por canal, turno y campaña. •    Colaborar con Recursos Humanos en la planeación de necesidades de contratación (headcount) anticipando el crecimiento o estacionalidad de cada canal y equipo. 2. Programación y gestión de personal (Scheduling) •    Analizar los recursos humanos disponibles para la atención de llamadas y demás canales, asegurando cobertura adecuada por intervalo y por equipo (Cobranza, Atención a Cliente, Ventas). •    Diseñar, publicar y ajustar horarios y turnos de agentes con base en la demanda pronosticada. •    Gestionar solicitudes de cambios de turno, vacaciones, permisos e incidencias, evitando afectaciones al nivel de servicio. •    Calcular y dar seguimiento al shrinkage (ausentismo, capacitaciones, tiempos improductivos) y a la adherencia al horario (schedule adherence). 3. Gestión en tiempo real (Real-Time Management) •    Monitorear en tiempo real el comportamiento de los canales de contacto y ajustar al personal disponible según se requiera. •    Detectar desviaciones entre lo pronosticado y lo real, y proponer/ejecutar acciones correctivas inmediatas (reasignación de agentes entre colas o campañas, horas extra, entre otras). •    Analizar el abandono de llamadas, identificar causas raíz y proponer e implementar planes de acción para reducirlo. •    Dar seguimiento y optimizar la ocupación y la utilización de los agentes. 4. Administración de tecnología de telefonía y omnicanalidad •    Optimizar los recursos tecnológicos de telefonía, incluyendo troncales (trunks) y DIDs, asegurando capacidad suficiente y un uso eficiente de los costos. •    Administrar el enrutamiento de llamadas (IVR, colas de espera, skills-based routing) y la distribución de carga entre los canales digitales (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS). •    Configurar y dar mantenimiento a los parámetros del discador predictivo (ratios de marcación, pacing, listas de contacto) para las campañas de cobranza y ventas salientes, cuidando el cumplimiento de horarios y frecuencia de contacto permitidos. •    Coordinar con las áreas de IT/Telecomunicaciones la resolución de incidencias, el mantenimiento preventivo y los proyectos de mejora de la plataforma de contacto. •    Evaluar e implementar nuevas tecnologías o funcionalidades (telefonía, discador, canales digitales) que mejoren la eficiencia operativa y la experiencia del cliente. 5. Análisis y reportes •    Elaborar y distribuir reportes diarios, semanales y mensuales de tráfico y desempeño: nivel de servicio (SLA), TMO/AHT, ASA, ocupación, abandono y demás KPIs, por canal y campaña. •    Realizar análisis comparativos entre lo planeado y lo real (forecast vs. actual) y proponer mejoras continuas al proceso de planeación. •    Presentar hallazgos, riesgos y recomendaciones a la Dirección de Operaciones para la toma de decisiones. 6. Colaboración interdepartamental •    Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Cobranza, Atención a Cliente y Ventas para entender las necesidades específicas de cada campaña y canal. •    Apoyar a Recursos Humanos y Capacitación en la planeación de nuevas contrataciones y horarios de entrenamiento, minimizando el impacto en el servicio. •    Servir como punto de contacto entre Operaciones e IT para temas relacionados con la infraestructura de telefonía y canales digitales. Requisitos del Puesto •    Licenciatura en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Actuaría, Estadística, Telecomunicaciones o carrera afín (o experiencia equivalente demostrable). •    Conocimiento de tecnología de telefonía IP, troncales SIP, DIDs, IVR y discadores predictivos. •    Manejo avanzado de Excel; deseable conocimiento de Power BI, SQL u otras herramientas de análisis de datos. •    Conocimiento de canales digitales de contacto (WhatsApp Business API, SMS, RCS) — deseable. •    Conocimiento de normativa y buenas prácticas aplicables a la industria de cobranza — deseable. •    Experiencia en marcadores predictivos indispensable. •    Conocimiento en configuración de marcadores predictivos y campañas masivas multicanal. •    Experiencia de 2 a 4 años en puestos de Workforce Management, Tráfico o Planeación de Call Center, preferentemente en cobranza, servicios financieros o BPO. •    Conocimiento y aplicación de modelos de dimensionamiento de personal (Erlang C). •    Experiencia con herramientas de WFM (por ejemplo: NICE, Verint, Aspect, Genesys, inContact, Avaya, o similares). •    Inglés conversacional intermedio.
